office_does: The three county commissioners adopt Pend Oreille County's budget and tax levies, set land-use and road policy and oversee county departments; District 2's commissioner is elected by the whole county.
race_blurb: Two Republicans finished one vote apart in the district-only primary. Incumbent Robert Rosencrantz runs against data centers, for holding taxes down and on his road and housing record; small-business owner Brandy Parker Warren runs on collaboration and responsible growth. A data center proposed for the former Usk paper mill hangs over the race: the Spokesman-Review reported that Warren's husband manages at the developer, Merkle Standard.

candidates.summary: Commissioner since 2021 and a commercial real estate owner, running to stop data centers, hold taxes down and keep road money for roads.
highlights: Says his first reason for running is to stop data centers from being built in the county [S4][S7]
Opposes road levy shifts and pledges to hold taxes down while keeping essential services [S1][S4]
Helped secure nearly $5 million to renovate Kaniksu Village Apartments in Metaline Falls [S6]
Petitioned the State Board of Health to restore a 100-foot septic setback from the river [S6]
Led the district-only primary by one vote, 670 to 669 [S10]

experience.basis: Incumbent commissioner since 2021, elected in 2022, running on his record ('I get results') with prior hospital and library board service.

taxes.basis: Pledges to maintain essential services 'while holding taxes down' and to protect taxpayers; no proposal to cut existing taxes.

spending.basis: Says county government should spend carefully, focus on the highest priorities and stay accountable to taxpayers; opposes using road levy shifts to balance the budget.

candidates.summary: Newport small-business owner and youth soccer leader in her first race for county office, running on collaboration, infrastructure, public safety and responsible growth.
highlights: Owns Lucky Bee Variety Store in Newport and Squatchee's Scoops & Swirls in Priest River [S1][S4]
Promises community-driven, collaborative and transparent leadership focused on solutions [S1][S3]
Endorsed by the mayors of Newport, Metaline Falls, Cusick and Metaline and Commissioner John Gentle [S5]
News reports say her husband is a manager at Merkle Standard, the Usk data center developer; her materials do not address data centers [S7][S8]

experience.basis: First run for county office against an incumbent; her experience is small business and volunteer boards, and she pitches community-driven leadership rather than an outsider overhaul.
